name: XTR rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 221 g for the exact RD-M9000-GS 11-speed GS reference. The selected 2015 weight is preserved; the 2017 specification table separately supplies the double-chainring reference limits and a distinct 46T single-chainring allowance.

technical_document.title: Shimano 2015 TSS manual, PDF/printed page 18: XTR RD-M9000-GS explicitly 221 g; CS-M9000 eleven-speed 11/13/15/17/19/21/24/27/31/35/40T cassette explicitly 331 g

sources.title: Shimano 2015 TSS manual, PDF/printed page 18: XTR RD-M9000-GS explicitly 221 g; CS-M9000 eleven-speed 11/13/15/17/19/21/24/27/31/35/40T cassette explicitly 331 g
Shimano 2017 TSS manual, PDF/printed page 283: XTR RD-M9000-GS 37T capacity, 10T front difference, 11T smallest sprocket; largest sprocket 42T double / 46T single

specifications.reference_configuration: GS, 2x11-speed reference; the separate 46T largest-sprocket allowance is for a single chainring.
